body.processed: (from the webpage) >This usage example shows how to produce two-color images from spectrally unmixed data sets. It was written for an Alexa647/Alexa700 measurement on the Würzburg 1 biplane setup as documented in [Aufmkolk2012]. The first two tasks in this example produce prerequisite knowledge for the image generation, the alignment information (Produce linear alignment matrix) and the F2 ratios, i.e. the relative intensity of fluorophores between the channels. [Aufmkolk2012] Hochauflösende Mehrfarben-Fluoeszenzmikroskopie. Sarah Aufmkolk. Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg. 2012-mar.
